title: derived_class classes every gate of an item touching kb/_self/token-efficiency.md as secrets, since SECRET_WORDS matches token in the path
goal: A gate on an item whose touches name kb/_self/token-efficiency.md (a doc about token cost, not a secret) is classed by its question and its other touches, not secrets: SECRET_WORDS in _tools/bl_authority.py no longer matches the word token inside that doc's path, while a touch that names a token file (a .token, tokens.json or an auth token store) still classes secrets. Found in SP-sz5fbvqn: BG-g3kbc72r's provisional gate g1 about the clip window became a blocking secrets gate.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_authority as a; c=a.derived_class({'touches':['kb/_self/token-efficiency.md']},{'id':'g1','question':'which window width'}); print(c); sys.exit(0 if c=='design' else 1)

gates.question: How does a touch's path name a token file for the secrets class: the word token anywhere but in the file name of a Markdown doc (.md), or only token as a whole file-name word or extension (token, tokens, .token) wherever it stands?
